notes: Eclipse Loop 1.2.0 — Arranger polish + mixer fixes Song Arranger - Color-coded toolbar: each tool has its own color, green PLAY / red STOP, and the active tool now lights up. Follows your theme. - Fuller right-click menu: Tools submenu + copy / cut / duplicate / paste, split at playhead, add marker, select / deselect all. - Click anywhere on the ruler to move the playhead, and the timeline auto-scrolls to follow playback. - Shift-drag the ruler to set the loop region. Mixer & transport - Master fader always opens at unity (0 dB) — no more reopening muted. - The Mixer opens in front of the arranger instead of behind it. - Mixer and Arrange windows remember their size and position. - Spacebar plays whichever window is in front (loop vs song) instead of both at once. Docs - Updated manual and quickstart, in the app and on the site.
